subject: Update radioButton choices from a file

messages.author: 1c44d55fe94f67dc
messages.subject: Update radioButton choices from a file
parts:
Hi,
What i would like to do is the following : 

Part of ui.R : 
sidebarPanel(
    fileInput("file", "Importer fichier", multiple=FALSE, accept=".MSnset"),
    br(),
    radioButtons("highlight", "Highlight group number :", choices = nGroup),
    br(),
    
        
    actionButton("openButton","Open") ,
  
    conditionalPanel(
      condition <- "input.openButton > 0 && !$('html').hasClass('shiny-busy')",
      #br(),
      p(strong("Data processing is complete!"))
    )


 I would like to select a file via the interface, to open it ( it is a csv-like file) and then extract from this file some information (ie nGroup) that will correspond to the choices of the radioButtons.

Is there a mean to update the sidebarPanel like that ?

Thanks

Sam

messages.author: 1c44d55fe94f67dc
messages.subject: Re: Update radioButton choices from a file
parts:
I tried this code, based on a tutorial : 

server.R
 output$nGroup <- renderUI({
    input$openButton
    if (input$openButton == 0) {
      # User has not uploaded a file yet
      return(NULL)
    }
    isolate(input$file)
    inFile <- input$file
    
    load(inFile$datapath)
    # variable 'obj' is created by the function 'load'
    textInput("test", "test", value=length(unique(pData(obj)[,"Grp"])))
  })


ui.R
uiOutput("nGroup")

It works fine but when I replace the "textInput" by "radioButtons", if fails....
Any idea ?

Best

Sam
